correctness.rationale: For K1 join of a disjoint union of r cliques of sizes p_i, Laplacian eigenvalues 0,1,p_i+1,n yield explicit entries. With a=f(h), b_i=f((p_i+1)h), c=f(nh), apex/base E=(1-c)/n; cross-blade D=(N+c-na)/(Nn)>=0 from convex Jensen f(h)<= (N+c)/n; within-blade W_i=D+(a-b_i)/p_i >= E from secant monotonicity (the identity D+(a-c)/N=E). All diagonals >0 from nonnegative spectral coefficients and 1/n all-ones projector. Thus E>=0 iff the whole matrix >=0, including r=1, singletons, h=0 and equality. Even Taylor F_p positive and F_p''=F_(p-2)>0, giving unique positive level-one return beta_p and threshold beta_p/n. Independent exact-rational matrix products matched projector formula/positivity implications in heterogeneous small graphs; cannot replace the unrestricted spectral proof.

Horváth (2005) and Horváth–Song–Terlaky (2014/2015) discuss general positivity/CFL thresholds; accessible abstracts do not establish the exact clique-block spectral iff.
